name: agentic-hq
description: Agentic HQ - Orchestrating agentic software development teams

scripts.// POSTINSTALL: node-pty spawn-helper exec-bit repair — a Node script so install works on Windows too (AHQ-211; the previous chmod shell string failed under cmd). darwin-only no-op elsewhere; see scripts/postinstall.cjs for the full story (AHQ-198). Shipped plugin .sh exec bits are handled by the generated release manifest's publishConfig.executableFiles instead (AHQ-197) — see scripts/build-release.cjs.
scripts.// PREPACK: Wrong-tree publish guard (AHQ-198): the repo root must never be packed/published — the publishable artifact is the staged release tree. npm runs prepack even on a private package (private: true blocks publish but NOT pack), so this fails every root pack/publish loudly. prepack never runs at install time. See scripts/prepack-guard.cjs.
scripts.// BUILD: Two separate builds (AHQ-208): build:framework = Framework Build (1), incremental tsc of src/ into <repo>/dist (JS + .d.ts + maps) — the dev wrapper agentic-hq-dev runs it automatically before every run. build = the release build for publishing: Framework Build (1) + a Workflow Build (2) per shipped migrated workflow + staging the release/ tree — exactly what ships, under a single generated manifest. Packing runs FROM release/ (cd release && pnpm pack). See scripts/build-release.cjs for the steps.
scripts.// VALIDATION: validate = typecheck + lint + format + unit tests (REQUIRED before commits)
scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.validate:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:all
scripts.// demo:agentic-hq-cli: Uses 'node bin/agentic-hq.cjs' (the agentic-hq-dev wrapper file) directly — self-contained, no global PATH dependency (same as the e2e test)
scripts.// DEMO: STRING REVERSAL: Two ways to run the string reversal demo (override the built-in default with -- --string-to-reverse='your string')
scripts.// demo:plugin-direct: Runs the workflow program directly via the shared runner (Framework Build (1) + build-first Workflow Build (2)), bypassing the agentic-hq CLI. The directory options are relative on purpose — cmd.exe has no $PWD; the runner resolves them against the working directory (AHQ-211).
scripts.// SETUP COMMANDS: One-time machine-setup steps. setup:trust-tmp-dir = trust the e2e temp workspace base in Claude Code — required once per machine before any Claude-spawning test (untrusted base = silent hang, AHQ-213)
scripts.// TEST COMMANDS: test = unit tests, test:unit = same as test, test:all = unit + integration + e2e
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.// test:e2e:prebuilt-tarball-math-workfl: No `pnpm build` prefix needed — the test's beforeAll runs the build itself
scripts.// WATCH MODE DISABLED: Watch mode causes AI test execution to hang

// node-pty: Pinned to an EXACT version (no ^) on purpose — supply-chain safety. Its install/build script is ALLOWED to run on Linux (AHQ-170: node-pty ships no linux-x64 prebuild, so it compiles from source on install), which means a new release would execute its own code at install time. An auto-bumped (^) version could therefore run a compromised release's build script. Keep pinned; upgrade ONLY manually after reviewing the release. See https://agentic-hq.atlassian.net/browse/AHQ-170
// @types/node: Pinned to the LOWEST supported Node major (22), not the newest. @types/node's major should track the oldest Node LTS the project supports so typecheck reflects that runtime's API surface. See AHQ-145.
